notes: ACCESS: plain direct fetch via probe.fetch (curl_cffi), HTTP 200 first attempt on every URL; no proxy, no r.jina.ai. robots.txt (https://www.theone.com/robots.txt) names no Claude / anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot agent; User-agent:* disallows only /account*, /cart*, /checkout*, /wishlist.html, /return.html, /my-order.html, /address-book.html, /producttag/ and /search - none of which were touched. No Crawl-delay declared; probe.py's 2s/host gap was used anyway. The assigned /en-ae/ path 301s to the bare host; canonical category URLs are https://www.theone.com/category/<slug> and already serve the UAE (en-ae) catalogue (the PLP's own API call pins country=en-ae). TREE: the complete mega-menu (every department and every child, 3 levels deep) ships in the static homepage HTML - 197 distinct /category/ anchors were parsed from it. Departments are New, Living, Dining, Bed & Bath, Lighting, Home Decor, Sale. Cross-checked against https://www.theone.com/sitemap.xml (1,377 locs, 208 of them /category/ URLs): the sitemap contains no /category/ slug beyond the mega-menu set, so the menu is exhaustive. There is NO Bathroom / Sanitaryware / Bath Furniture department on this site - The One is a furniture and soft-furnishing retailer and sells no sanitaryware, baths, showers, enclosures, taps, toilets or basins at all. Grepping all 208 category slugs for bath|shower|toilet|sanitary|vanity|basin|sink|mirror|tap|faucet|wash returned only the Bed & Bath tree, Home Decor > Mirrors, and their New-/Sale- promotional mirrors. The single genuine Bathroom node is Bed & Bath > Towels & Bath Accessories > Bath Accessories. Its sibling Towels & Bath Mats is textile and was routed out (see review). The parent Towels & Bath Accessories has extractable children so it is recorded as a grouping row with blank qty and blank URL per the parent-URL rule (its own total is 36 = 30 + 6, confirming the split is complete and nothing sits directly on the parent). QTY: the listing header (#km-plp-count, ' Items') is filled client-side, so the number comes from the PLP's own request - GET engine.kartmax.in/api/fast/search/v1/9dd12b5a96ce9a456540475ea0b340e1/plp-special with the query string copied verbatim out of each category page's inline DOMContentLoaded script (category identity = fieldspecials _uuid; the page's own call also pins overall_stock_status~in-stock and country=en-ae, so result.count is the shopper-visible population). UUIDs read live: Bath Accessories b9gComyt9VkrUJG8, Towels & Bath Mats JnysKeix3vn5bNdq, Towels & Bath Accessories a2adcd2bc10cee66. VERIFICATION: result.count was not trusted alone. Bath Accessories was paged to exhaustion at count=100 - page 1 returned exactly 30 tiles with 30 unique product_ids, page 2 returned zero tiles, matching result.count=30 exactly. Towels & Bath Mats likewise enumerated 6/6. The three counts discriminate (30 / 6 / 36) and are not a site-wide constant; children sum exactly to the parent (30+6=36). Each page's H1 was checked against the node requested and matched: 'Bath Accessories', 'Towels & Bath Mats', 'Towels & Bath Accessories'. Product-level evidence that Bath Accessories is genuinely Bathroom (rules 13/14/17): toilet paper holders (BELLWOOD, CAPPA x2, FLEX, TUCAN), toilet brush (STEP), soap dishes (STEP, DROPLET), soap pumps (DENYA, PRISM, DROPLET), tumbler (DROPLET), toothbrush holder (BLANC), towel holder (MARBLE), double towel tree (PALM), towel ladders (LEANA x2), bath sets (TIVORA set of 4, MARBLE set of 5), canister, organiser, bathroom boxes and two bathroom mirrors (BEND shelf with mirror, CUBIKO wall mirror with storage). EXCLUDED: Home Decor > Mirrors (24 products) - full enumeration shows decorative wall and floor mirrors (CARSON, CATANIA, BELLWOOD floor mirror, TANTRA floor mirror, HUBBA, IONA etc.); primary type is decorative mirror under the Home Decor hierarchy, not bathroom, so per rules 5/29 it stays with Home Decor and was NOT duplicated into Bathroom. Bed & Bath > Dressers & Mirrors is bedroom dressing furniture. All New/* and Sale/* branches mirror the full tree and are promotional navigation (rule 25), as are the 'All <Department>' nodes; none were recorded. No Bathroom Lighting node exists on this site (Lighting is only Ceiling / Table / Floor Lamps), so nothing was routed to Lighting.
